_meta.description: Version-gated Drupal facts. Each fact applies when since <= version < until. Every entry cites a change record or core file; scripts/drupal-facts quotes the citation. Keep this list short: only facts that agents get wrong without it.

facts.statement: Hooks can be implemented as classes in src/Hook/ with the #[Hook] attribute on autowired services.
facts.note: Use #[LegacyHook] on the procedural shim for 10.x compatibility. Stay procedural in every version: hook_install, hook_schema, hook_update_N, hook_post_update_NAME, hook_hook_info, hook_module_implements_alter. hook_theme CAN be #[Hook('theme')] on 11.1+ (core does it). hook_requirements: procedural in 11.1; from 11.2 runtime/update checks are #[Hook('runtime_requirements')] / #[Hook('update_requirements')], and a procedural hook_requirements needs #[LegacyRequirementsHook] on 11.3+ (removed in 13.0).

facts.statement: #[Hook] supports order (Order::First/Last, OrderBefore/After), #[ReorderHook], #[RemoveHook], and preprocess hooks.
facts.note: Secondary-sourced details; confirm the record before quoting specifics.

facts.statement: Themes can implement hooks with #[Hook] in their src/Hook/ directory.
Procedural hooks in .module files are still supported and not formally deprecated.
facts.note: Deprecation is planned; removal no earlier than Drupal 13. Do not rewrite procedural hooks unrequested.

facts.statement: Plugin discovery supports PHP attributes (e.g. #[Block], #[FieldType]) for core plugin types.
facts.note: Contrib plugin types may still require annotations; check the plugin manager of that type, not the core version.

facts.statement: Plugin types must provide an attribute class: a plugin manager without one is deprecated in 11.2 and unsupported in 12.0; plugin implementations still using annotations are deprecated and removed in 13.0.
Recipes (recipe.yml with config actions) can be applied to a site.
Entity queries must call accessCheck(TRUE|FALSE) explicitly; omitting it throws.
format_size() is deprecated in 10.2 and removed in 11.0; never call it on 11.x — use \Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\ByteSizeMarkup::create().
facts.note: Applies from the deprecation onward (the function is absent on 11.x); 'until' is null on purpose so 11.x agents still see it. Deprecated-in version = since.

facts.statement: watchdog_exception() is deprecated in 10.1 and removed in 11.0; never call it on 11.x — use \Drupal\Core\Utility\Error::logException() with an injected logger.
facts.note: Applies from the deprecation onward (the function is absent on 11.x); 'until' is null on purpose so 11.x agents still see it. Deprecated-in version = since.

facts.statement: system_time_zones() is deprecated in 10.1 and removed in 11.0; never call it on 11.x — use \Drupal\Core\Datetime\TimeZoneFormHelper.
facts.note: Applies from the deprecation onward (the function is absent on 11.x); 'until' is null on purpose so 11.x agents still see it. Deprecated-in version = since.

facts.statement: Drupal 12 requires PHP 8.5 and an upgrade path from 11.4 or later.
Kernel, Functional and FunctionalJavascript test classes must carry #[RunTestsInSeparateProcesses]; omitting it is deprecated in 11.3.0 and throws an exception in 12.0.0.
facts.note: Verified against 11.4.6 core on 2026-09-04: the trigger_error text in both base classes.
